content.text:
You’ve got a few good options, depending on **how soon you need it** and whether you want **local delivery or nationwide shipping**:

### Fast / same-day options
- **Instacart** — order cakes from local grocery-store bakeries like Publix, Safeway, Kroger, Costco, Whole Foods, etc., depending on your area. Good for same-day delivery or pickup. ([instacart.com](https://www.instacart.com/cake-delivery?msockid=0a91e198ca3d61653a14f744cb876021&utm_source=openai))  
- **Local bakery websites** — search “birthday cake delivery near me” or use Google Maps/Yelp; many bakeries now take online orders for pickup or delivery.
- **DoorDash / Uber Eats / Grubhub** — often list local bakeries, grocery bakeries, cupcake shops, and dessert shops.

### Nationwide delivery / shipped cakes
- **Goldbelly** — best for specialty or famous bakery cakes shipped nationwide. Good if you want something memorable, like a Milk Bar-style cake, cheesecake, or regional bakery cake. ([goldbelly.com](https://www.goldbelly.com/collections/best-birthday-cakes?utm_source=openai))  
- **Bake Me A Wish!** — specializes in birthday cakes and bakery gifts shipped nationwide. ([bakemeawish.com](https://www.bakemeawish.com/?utm_source=openai))  
- **We Take The Cake** — ships decorated cakes and dessert gifts nationwide. ([wetakethecake.com](https://wetakethecake.com/?utm_source=openai))  
- **Carlo’s Bakery** — offers nationwide shipping and local pickup options for birthday cakes and pastries. ([live.carlosbakery.com](https://live.carlosbakery.com/?utm_source=openai))  
- **Sprinkles** — good for cupcakes and some cakes, with local pickup/delivery in certain cities and shipping options. ([sprinkles.com](https://sprinkles.com/?utm_source=openai))  

### My quick recommendation
- Need it **today/tomorrow**: use **Instacart** or a **local bakery**.
- Want a **custom message/design**: order directly from a **local bakery** if possible.
- Sending a cake to someone in another state: use **Goldbelly**, **Bake Me A Wish!**, or **We Take The Cake**.

If you tell me the **city/ZIP code**, **date needed**, and your **budget**, I can narrow it down to the best options near you.
